name: Domestic Animals
overview: Scripture reveals that God created domestic animals as part of His good creation and entrusted mankind with dominion over them, highlighting humanity’s unique role as caretakers (Genesis 1:26). From the beginning, Adam was given authority to name and relate to the creatures, demonstrating a personal stewardship (Genesis 2:19). The Bible affirms that a righteous person shows compassion toward their animals, reflecting God’s design for mercy in human-animal relationships (Proverbs 12:10). Moreover, God’s providential care for the birds of the air reminds believers of their greater value and His sustaining power (Matthew 6:26), while all breathing creatures are called to praise the Lord (Psalms 150:6). Even the behavior of animals can teach spiritual truths to those who observe them attentively (Job 12:7).
